'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Kharkiv strikes (2022–present)|Kharkiv strikes]]
****[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] target [[Kharkiv]] with at least 13 [[HESA Shahed 136|Geran-2]] [[drone warfare|drones]], causing fires in industrial and residential areas and injuring eight people, including a child. [https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2025/04/2/7505613/ (''Ukrainska Pravda'')]
***[[Kryvyi Rih strikes (2022–present)|Kryvyi Rih strikes]]
****A Russian [[missile]] strike on an [[industrial park]] in [[Kryvyi Rih]], [[Ukraine]], kills at least four people and injures 14 others. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/zelenskiy-urges-pressure-moscow-russian-missile-kills-four-kryvyi-rih-2025-04-02/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Siege of El Fasher]]
***At least two [[civilian]]s are killed in the [[artillery]] [[shell (projectile)|shelling]] of a [[internal displacement|displacement camp]] in [[El Fasher]], [[North Darfur]], [[Sudan]], by the [[Rapid Support Forces]]. [https://apnews.com/article/sudan-displacement-famine-elfasher-military-rapid-support-forces-un-38b47acc8fd199f7d5873423bfb441d3 (AP)]
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Israeli invasion of Syria (2024–present)|Israeli invasion of Syria]]
***The [[Israeli Air Force]] launches [[airstrike]]s in [[Syria]] targeting the remaining "[[Syrian Armed Forces|military]] infrastructure", destroying much of [[Hama Air Base]] and [[Tiyas Air Base]], including all remaining [[hangar]]s and [[radar]]s. The [[Barzah scientific research centre]] is also reportedly bombed. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-confirms-syrian-airstrikes-saying-it-struck-remaining-military-capabilities-at-hama-military-airport-t-4-airbase/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
****[[Israel]]i [[Prime Minister of Israel|prime minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] announces the country's [[Israeli Defence Forces|military]] will seize large areas of land in the [[Gaza Strip]] and establish a new [[military occupation|occupation zone]] called the [[Morag (Israeli settlement)|Morag]] Corridor, potentially stretching from [[Rafah]] to [[Khan Younis]]. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-news-gaza-operation-04-02-2025-6b653fc8fa1e6f0c1a0c8d322bd48ccc (AP)]
***Israeli [[strikes]] have killed more than 30 [[Palestinians]], due to Israel’s military operation in the [[Gaza Strip]] expanding to seize large areas. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/israel-expands-military-effort-in-gaza-says-defence-minister-katz/article69402667.ece (The Hindu)]
**[[Iran–United States relations]]
***The [[United States Air Force]] deploys 6 nuclear-capable [[Northrop B-2 Spirit|B-2 stealth bombers]] to [[Diego Garcia]], amid rising tensions with Iran over their [[Nuclear program of Iran|nuclear program]]. [https://apnews.com/article/b2-bombers-us-yemen-houthis-iran-israel-hamas-war-487247ed0d6c8743b21d18740b649d1c (AP)]
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**The [[Provisional Government of Myanmar|Myanmar government]] declares a temporary [[ceasefire]] with the [[National Unity Government of Myanmar|National Unity Government]]-in-exile and its various allied [[List of ethnic armed organisations in Myanmar|ethnic armed organizations]] to facilitate [[disaster response|relief efforts]] following the [[2025 Myanmar earthquake|M{{sub|W}} 7.7 earthquake]] in the country several days ago. The ceasefire is expected to last until April 22. [https://www.dw.com/en/myanmar-military-declares-truce-to-facilitate-quake-relief/a-72112808 (DW)]
*[[M23 campaign (2022–present)]]
**[[2025 Walikale offensive]]
***[[Wazalendo]] militias break through [[March 23 Movement]] (M23) positions in Kampala, DRC, and launch an attack on the M23 rebels in [[Walikale]]. [https://www.criticalthreats.org/briefs/congo-war-security-review/congo-war-security-review-april-2-2025#_edn51510bdfe07cd2d09075a7fc5bffe9171 (Critical Threats)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**An elder peasant is killed after the blasts of a landmine when was riding his motorcycle in a rural road in the community of Puerta de Alambre, [[Apatzingán]] municipality, [[Michoacán]]. [https://www.proceso.com.mx/nacional/2025/4/2/adulto-mayor-que-viajaba-en-moto-muere-tras-explotar-una-mina-en-apatzingan-348602.html (''Proceso'')]

'''Arts and culture'''
*Archaeologists with the [[Vienna Museum]] announce the discovery of a [[mass grave]] in [[Simmering (Vienna)|Simmering district]] in [[Vienna]], [[Austria]], of around 150 [[Ancient Roman]] [[Military of Ancient Rome|soldiers]] from the [[1st century]] who likely died in a [[Campaign history of the Roman military|battle]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/mass-roman-grave-discovered-outside-vienna/a-72121297 (DW)] [https://www.caledonianrecord.com/news/national/vienna-archaeologists-reveal-mass-grave-of-fighters-in-roman-empire-era-battle/article_4fdaa3b2-1a57-58da-96e5-5ac653b20e5d.html (''Caledonian Record'')]
*In a deal with [[20th Television Animation]], [[Fox Broadcasting Company|Fox]] announces a four-season, 15-episode renewal for [[The Simpsons]], [[Bob's Burgers]] and [[Family Guy]], along with [[American Dad!]], marking its return to the network since its 2005 debut, after an 11-year run on [[TBS (American TV channel)|TBS]]. [https://deadline.com/2025/04/the-simpsons-family-guy-bobs-burgers-american-dad-renewed-1236356360/ (''Deadline'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Tariffs in the second Trump administration]]
**[[China–United States trade war]], [[2025 United States trade war with Canada and Mexico]]
***[[Donald Trump's Liberation Day speech]]
****[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] announces a universal 10% [[tariff]] on most imports into the [[United States]], a 20% tariff on goods from the [[European Union]], and a 34% tariff on all imports from [[China]]. The tariffs will take effect from April 5. 
****Exceptions include [[Canada]], [[Cuba]], [[Mexico]], [[North Korea]], and [[Russia]]. Canada and Mexico had [[2025 United States trade war with Canada and Mexico|tariffs placed on them in February]], while Cuba, North Korea, and Russia are [[United States government sanctions|under U.S. sanctions]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/c1dr7vy39eet (BBC News)] [https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20250402-live-us-stocks-fall-ahead-of-trump-s-liberation-day-tariff-announcement (France 24)] [https://www.indiatoday.in/business/story/russia-canada-north-korea-and-mexico-among-countries-missing-from-donald-trump-reciprocal-tariff-list-2703234-2025-04-03 (India Today)]
****In the 10% tariff, the U.S. lists the [[Australia]]n territory of [[Heard Island and McDonald Islands]] near [[Antarctica]], despite the fact that it has no human inhabitants, imports or exports. In response to finding these islands in the list, [[Prime Minister of Australia|Australian prime minister]] [[Anthony Albanese]] commented that "Nowhere on earth is safe" for the tariff. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2025/apr/03/donald-trump-tariffs-antarctica-uninhabited-heard-mcdonald-islands (The Guardian)]
***The [[United States Senate]] votes 51–48 on a [[non-binding resolution]] to rebuke and reverse tariffs on Canada, with [[Republican Party (United States)|Republicans]] [[Rand Paul]], [[Susan Collins]], [[Lisa Murkowski]], and [[Mitch McConnell]] voting for the resolution. [https://www.npr.org/2025/04/02/nx-s1-5347699/senate-trump-tariffs-canada (NPR)]

**The [[World Meteorological Organization]] retires ''[[Hurricane Beryl|Beryl]]'', ''[[Hurricane Helene|Helene]]'', ''[[Hurricane Milton|Milton]]'', and ''[[Hurricane John (2024)|John]]'' from their rotating list of names for hurricanes for the [[Atlantic hurricane|North Atlantic]] and [[Pacific hurricane|East Pacific]] basins. [https://wmo.int/news/media-centre/wmo-hurricane-committee-retires-names-of-beryl-helene-milton-and-john (WMO)]
*A microbus collided head-on with a bus in [[Lohagara Upazila]], [[Bangladesh]], killing 10 and injuring three others. [https://bdnews24.com/bangladesh/5da6cf20b08f (bdnews24)]
*Five people are killed and at least one other is critically injured when a private [[Maharashtra State Road Transport Corporation]] bus [[Head-on collision|collides head-on]] with two vehicles on the Khamgaon-Shegaon highway in [[Buldhana]], [[Maharashtra]], [[India]]. [https://www.news18.com/india/five-killed-after-bus-crashes-into-suv-in-maharashtras-buldhana-ws-b-9283566.html (News18 India)]
*A [[Russian Air Force]] [[Tupolev Tu-22M]] [[strategic bomber]] crashes due to a technical malfunction in [[Irkutsk Oblast]], [[Russia]], killing one crew member and injuring three others. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-strategic-bomber-crashes-siberia-one-person-dead-agencies-report-2025-04-02/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*The [[Slovakia|Slovak]] [[Government of Slovakia|government]] approves a plan to [[culling|cull]] 350 [[Eurasian brown bear|brown bear]]s after a man was found [[animal attack|mauled]] by a bear on March 30. The government had previously culled 144 bears in 2024. [https://apnews.com/article/slovakia-bears-cull-attack-safety-37475360ffcb9eda5f8429971f876e9b (AP)]
*The [[Poland|Polish]] [[Government of Poland|government]] increases border controls with [[Slovakia]] in response to the [[Foot-and-mouth disease#Hungary and Slovakia (2025)|outbreak of foot-and-mouth disease]] among Slovakia's and [[Hungary]]'s [[livestock]]. [https://tvn24.pl/biznes/z-kraju/rygorystyczne-kontrole-na-granicach-st8392019 (TVN24)]
